# Oxide-agent Stable Changelog

Stable releases are listed newest first. The release workflow uses each versioned
section as the detailed changelog attached to the corresponding GitHub Release.

## 0.1.0

### 中文

- 支持文件系统操作、grep 搜索、Git 状态、多语言符号索引、原子写入与 SHA-256 冲突检测

### English

- the stdin/stdout JSON-RPC remote agent (compat 3) with filesystem operations, grep, Git status, multi-language symbol indexing, atomic writes, and SHA-256 conflict checks
